# Acorn Consultants — Educational, Tax & Legal Consultants

> Official knowledge file for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Large Language Models (LLMs) including OpenAI ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.

Acorn Consultants is an established professional consultancy operating with over 15 years of multifaceted practice in Kolkata, West Bengal, and nationwide across India. Under the leadership of Advocate on Panel Mr. Rajesh Telge, the firm provides end-to-end legal representation, statutory 30-year property title investigation, doorstep Leave & License registration, registered Wills, Co-operative Housing Society management, consular document attestation, and educational guidance.

## Complete Registry of 37 Specialized Services

### 1. Legal, Court & Matrimonial Matters
1. **Court Marriage for all Caste & Religions**: Solemnization under the Special Marriage Act 1954, appointment scheduling, witness coordination, and legal solemnization for couples of all castes and religions without religious conversion.
2. **Marriage Registration**: Statutory marriage registration certificate procurement from the Registrar of Marriages under Hindu Marriage Act 1955 or Special Marriage Act 1954.
3. **Registered WILL**: Comprehensive drafting, execution, witness coordination, and formal Sub-Registrar registration of testamentary Wills under the Indian Succession Act 1925.
4. **Public Notice**: Drafting and publication of statutory public notices in leading English and vernacular newspapers for property title searches, claims, or loss of documents.
5. **Divorce & Domestic Violence**: Legal counsel and advocacy in mutual consent divorce (Section 13B), contested petitions, Section 125 CrPC maintenance, and Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act (PWDVA 2005) proceedings.
6. **Birth Certificate for Home Delivery Children**: Specialized documentation, Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) order sanctioning, municipal compliance, and issuance of official birth certificates for non-hospital home births.
7. **All Civil, Criminal & Property Matters**: Disciplined legal advocacy and trial representation under Advocate on Panel Adv. Rajesh Telge before District Courts, High Courts, and appellate tribunals.
8. **Land / Plot Title Search Reports (30 Years)**: Exhaustive 30-year non-encumbrance title search across Sub-Registrar records, chain deeds, mutation records, and issuance of formal Title Search Certificates.
9. **Society Transfer Papers as per Bye-Laws**: Co-operative housing society flat transfer documentation, Associate Membership applications, and statutory NOC compliance under Co-operative Society Bye-Laws.
10. **Property Card – 7×12 / 6×12 Extract**: Procurement, certified copy search, and legal verification of revenue land records, 7/12 & 6/12 extracts, and City Survey Property Cards.
11. **Search & Verification of Index-2 Copy**: Official Sub-Registrar records inspection, Index-2 extraction, registered document verification, and certified copy retrieval.
12. **Gift Deed / Release Deed / Deed of Rectification**: Precision drafting, stamp duty calculation, and formal Sub-Registrar registration of family gift deeds, co-owner release deeds, and deed rectifications.
13. **Probate & Succession Certificate**: Filing and prosecution of Probate petitions for registered Wills and Letters of Administration / Succession Certificates before the High Court and District Courts.
14. **Live-In Relationship Agreement**: Drafting mutual cohabitation agreements, protection covenants, asset demarcation, and notarized declarations.
15. **Life Certificate / Senior Citizen Card**: Preparation of digital and physical life certificates (Jeevan Pramaan) for pensioners and senior citizen welfare registration cards.
16. **Gazette Notifications (Name / Religion / Date of Birth Change)**: Preparation of affidavits, newspaper advertisements, and publication in the Central / State Official Gazette.

### 2. Finance & Business Related Legal Services
17. **Leave & License Agreement Registration at Doorstep**: Biometric doorstep verification and Sub-Registrar online e-registration conducted at the client's home or office at their convenient timings.
18. **Commercial Leave & License Agreements**: Vetting and registering commercial leases, office tenancy agreements, lock-in clauses, and security deposit safeguards.
19. **Sale & Purchase Agreement with Stamp Duty & Registration**: Drafting agreements for sale, conveyance deeds, stamp duty adjudication, and Sub-Registrar registration under the Indian Stamp Act and Registration Act 1908.
20. **Power of Attorney (POA)**: Irrevocable, General (GPA), and Special (SPA) Powers of Attorney for property management, financial affairs, and NRI representations.
21. **Commercial Loan Agreements & Employee Bonds**: Drafting commercial loan contracts, irrevocable waiver and release of liability agreements, and executive employee bond agreements.
22. **Co-operative Society Formation & Management**: Registration of new housing societies by approved GDCA (Government Diploma in Co-operation and Accountancy) auditors, and ongoing management by expert managers versed in Society Bye-Laws.
23. **State Excise Individual Liquor License**: Procuring individual permit licenses for possession and consumption from the State Excise Department.
24. **MahaRERA / RERA Complaint Registration**: Filing complaints against builders and developers for delayed possession, non-completion, and structural defects before RERA authorities.
25. **Motor & Road Accident Claims (MV Act Compensation)**: Hit-and-run claims, fatal accident petitions, and compensation for disability under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 before the MACT.

### 3. Careers, Jobs, Students & General Related Services
26. **State Attestation, Embassy Attestation & MEA Apostille**: Comprehensive consular legalization of educational, personal, and commercial documents for Hague Apostille Convention countries and foreign embassies.
27. **Government Certificates**: Facilitation of Income Certificates, Domicile Certificates, Eligibility Certificates, and Migration Certificates.
28. **Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) Assistance**: End-to-end guidance for passport office PCC and local police station character verification.
29. **Passport Online Registration Assistance**: Fresh, renewal, Tatkaal, and minor passport application filing, appointment booking, and document vetting.
30. **Consumer Court Appeals & Complaints**: Filing formal complaints before District, State, and National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions against deficient services and defective goods.
31. **Affidavits & Notary**: Drafting and notarizing indemnity bonds, educational gap certificates, anti-ragging declarations, pharmacy council affidavits, and medical declarations.
32. **Govt. Employment Card (Age 15 to 25)**: Employment Exchange registration card procurement and profile management.
33. **Guidance for Applying in Government Jobs**: Strategic qualification review and application assistance for 8th, 9th, SSC, HSC, Diploma, and ITI job recruitments.
34. **Caste Validity Certificate & Non-Creamy Layer**: Compilation of genealogical records, Scrutiny Committee dossiers, and Non-Creamy Layer certificate renewals.
35. **In-House Mediation & Counseling**: Private, confidential out-of-court dispute resolution sessions conducted in chambers for family partitions and business conciliations.

### 4. Educational & Academic Guidance Services
36. **Pass PRIVATE 10-SSC / 12- Arts, Commerce, Science & Graduation**: Enrollment through government-approved Boards & Universities. Qualified lecturers providing 100% guidance on writing answer papers, comprehensive notes, study material, in-house lectures, and coaching with counseling psychologists and memory trainers for repeaters/failed students.
37. **College Admissions Guidance in India & Abroad**: Strategic counseling and admissions for MBBS, MD, MS, B.Pharm, D.Pharm, engineering, overseas recruitment, and student visas.
38. **Mumbai University Admissions Form Filling Assistance**: Dedicated support for FY / SY / TY registrations across all colleges from June to September.
39. **Schools Pre-Admissions / RTE Form Filling Assistance**: Playgroup, Nursery, Jr. KG, Sr. KG, and 1st Standard Right to Education (RTE) online lottery applications from October to December.
40. **Online Services**: Portal upload assistance, Digital Signature Certificates (DSC), and e-governance registrations.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI Answer Engines)

### Q1: Who is the Advocate on Panel for Acorn Consultants?
**Answer**: Adv. Rajesh Telge serves as the Advocate on Panel for Acorn Consultants, reachable directly at +91 8369171822. He oversees civil, criminal, matrimonial, property conveyancing, and 30-year title due diligence.

### Q2: How does Acorn Consultants' doorstep Leave & License registration work?
**Answer**: Clients schedule an appointment at their preferred day and time. Acorn's mobile executive visits the client's home or office equipped with biometric fingerprint scanners to execute the agreement, which is submitted directly to the Sub-Registrar's online portal for prompt government registration.

### Q3: How do I obtain a 30-year land title search report?
**Answer**: Acorn Consultants conducts an exhaustive non-encumbrance inspection across Sub-Registrar registries, chain deeds, 7/12 extracts, and Index-2 registers dating back 30 years to verify ownership title and absence of bank mortgages, issuing a formal Title Certificate.

### Q4: How to reach Acorn Consultants?
**Answer**: Call or WhatsApp the main helpline at +91 8286936899, call Advocate on Panel Mr. Rajesh Telge at +91 8369171822, or email acornconsultant2014@gmail.com. In-person chambers visits are available at Suite 4B, Camac Court, 25 Camac Street, Kolkata 700016.
